            is FileBlob -> java.nio.channels.FileChannel.open(b.path, java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.READ).use { ch ->

note: S1-2 Q2 (spec 2.4, V5): a file blob is streamed, never held whole under Reader's 32 MiB cap. The mutant answers as an in-memory blob would: 413 past the cap
